definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 甲戌，江南國主李景遣泗州牙將王知朗賫書一函至滁州，本州以聞，書稱唐皇帝奉書於大周皇帝，其略云：「願陳兄事，永奉鄰歡，設或俯鑒遠圖，下交小國，悉班卒乘，俾乂蒼黔，慶雞犬之相聞，奉瓊瑤以為好，必當歲陳山澤之利，少助軍旅之須。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: On day jiaxu, Li Jing, ruler of Jiangnan, sent the Sizhou adjutant Wang Zhilang bearing one letter to Chuzhou; the prefecture reported it. The letter said the Tang Emperor presents a letter to the Great Zhou Emperor, in summary: "We wish to declare brotherly relations and forever maintain neighborly amity. If you would deign to regard our distant design and condescend to deal with our small state, we would deploy all our soldiers and chariots to bring peace to the black-haired people, rejoice that cock and dog call to one another across the border, and offer jade and treasures in friendship; we would surely present each year the products of mountain and marsh to aid somewhat the needs of your army.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: On day jiaxu, Li Jing, ruler of Jiangnan, sent the Sizhou adjutant Wang Zhilang bearing one letter to Chuzhou; the prefecture reported it. The letter said the Tang Emperor presents a letter to the Great Zhou Emperor, in summary: "We wish to declare brotherly relations and forever maintain neighborly amity. If you would deign to regard our distant design, condescend to deal with our small state, and withdraw all your soldiers and chariots to bring peace to the black-haired people, we would rejoice that cock and dog call to one another across the border, and offer jade and treasures in friendship; we would surely present each year the products of mountain and marsh to aid somewhat the needs of your army.

definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 昭諫曰：「昔唐初劉洎、馬周起徒步，太宗擢用為相，其後朱樸、柳璨在下僚，昭宗亦以大用，然則太宗用之於前而國興，昭宗用於後而國亡，士之難知也如此。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: Zhao remonstrated: "In early Tang, Liu Ji and Ma Zhou rose from foot soldiers; Taizong promoted them to chancellor. Later Zhu Pu and Liu Can were junior officials whom Zhaozong also greatly employed. Yet Taizong used men in the former case and the state flourished; Zhaozong used men in the latter case and the state perished. How difficult it is to know gentlemen is shown thus.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: Zhao remonstrated: "In early Tang, Liu Ji and Ma Zhou rose from among commoners on foot; Taizong promoted them to chancellor. Later Zhu Pu and Liu Can were junior officials whom Zhaozong also greatly employed. Yet Taizong used men in the former case and the state flourished; Zhaozong used men in the latter case and the state perished. How difficult it is to know gentlemen is shown thus.

replacements.with: rose from among commoners on foot
replacements.reason: 起徒步 means rising from humble commoner status (going on foot, without carriage); Liu Ji and Ma Zhou were not soldiers. The idiomatic "rose from obscurity" is correct.
